# GateLink configuration parameters

<!-- GENERATED by tools/config/dump_config_doc.cpp from lib/lran-config/include/lran/config/table.h.
     Do not edit. Regenerate with: python3 tools/checks/config_doc.py --write -->

**Every parameter GateLink holds, as `lib/lran-config/` declares it.** The table header is the
source (D44). This file, the firmware's defaults and the Home Assistant controls are all
derived from it, and `tools/checks/config_doc.py` fails CI when this file stops matching.

**A name is permanent once Home Assistant has published it**, because it is the entity's
`object_id` (Protocol Spec §16.7). Set a parameter on `lran/gatelink/config/set` (§16.7.2).
A value outside its range is clamped, and the clamp is reported (§7.4).

**The ranges are proposals, not measurements.** Each default comes from the GateLink PRD or
Implementation Plan §4.4, as the row's meaning cites.

## Every node's block, `0x0100`–`0x01FF`

GateLink holds these as every node does. The PHY rows change only as a fleet operation from
the bridge's topic (spec §12.4, D56, D59).

| ID | Name | Type | Unit | Default | Range | Access | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `0x0100` | `dedup_cache_depth` | u8 |  | 8 | 1 to 32 | read-write | Cached command results, spec 10.4 |
| `0x0101` | `frag_reassembly_timeout_ms` | u16 | ms | 5000 | 500 to 30000 | read-write | Fragment set window, spec 11.2 |
| `0x0102` | `cad_retries` | u8 |  | 5 | 0 to 10 | read-write | CAD attempts before transmitting regardless, spec 12.3 |
| `0x0103` | `backoff_max_ms` | u16 | ms | 1500 | 100 to 5000 | read-write | Upper bound of the random CAD backoff, spec 12.3 |
| `0x0110` | `freq_hz` | u32 | Hz | 917400000 | 902000000 to 928000000 | PHY group, spec 12.4 | Channel, spec 12.1 - fleet-wide |
| `0x0111` | `spreading_factor` | u8 |  | 9 | 7 to 12 | PHY group, spec 12.4 | SF, spec 12.1 - fleet-wide |
| `0x0112` | `bandwidth_khz` | u16 | kHz | 125 | 125 to 500 | PHY group, spec 12.4 | BW - 125 until an envelope decision, spec 18.2 |
| `0x0113` | `coding_rate_denominator` | u8 |  | 5 | 5 to 8 | PHY group, spec 12.4 | CR 4/N, spec 12.1 |
| `0x0114` | `tx_power_dbm` | i16 | dBm | -4 | -9 to -4 | PHY group, spec 12.4 | Conducted; the maximum IS D33's ceiling, spec 18.2 |
| `0x0115` | `phy_trial_s` | u16 | s | 120 | 30 to 900 | PHY group, spec 12.4 | Revert window after a PHY change, spec 12.4 |

## Held by the bridge for GateLink

These are set on GateLink's topic too, but the bridge applies them and never sends them to
the node (D47). They are not part of the node's readback.

| ID | Name | Type | Unit | Default | Range | Access | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `0x0080` | `poll_interval_s` | u16 | s | 60 | 10 to 3600 | read-write | Poll period for this node, BG-4 |
| `0x0081` | `deployed` | bool |  | 0 | 0 to 1 | read-write | Polled from boot, D61 |

## What a full readback costs

A `CONFIG_ACK` has 193 bytes for results (spec §7.4). GateLink's block takes 131 and every
node's block 68, so a full readback takes 199 bytes. It arrives as more than one message, marked
`MORE_FOLLOWS` (spec §7.4.1).
